Definition: Jair, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns, and called them Havoth-jair. He took all the country of Argob, and called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jair's name outlived him on the map: the towns he took kept his name for generations, and the land east of Jordan still says Havoth-jair long after the man who named it was gone.
